scope: Existing H200 session and connected vfolder metadata only. No installation, apt update, file write, database initialization/start, GPU work, port opening, or backup was performed.

observation_sources.description: Previously verified user session; OS, executable/package metadata, sudo listing, cgroup, /proc, and filesystem stat/mount information. Credentials and environment variables were not read or recorded.

Session RUNNING with 12 CPU / 240 GiB / 1 GPU; user storage allocation 2 TB, displayed use 192.91 GB (9.65%); novel-toy-tune vfolder READY and R/W. Storage figures are for the user allocation, not a measured per-folder quota.

technical_assessment.conclusion: A PostgreSQL 16 and pgvector setup is technically plausible: noninteractive sudo, apt-get, build tools, and a writable hard-mounted NFS vfolder are visible. PostgreSQL server/client and pgvector are not installed; database start, storage durability, restart, and restore have not been tested. This is not confirmation that a PostgreSQL database currently stores data on H200.
technical_assessment.systemd_absence_not_a_blocker: PID 1 is docker-init; systemctl presence does not establish usable systemd. PostgreSQL can be started with pg_ctl in a later authorized test.
remaining_unknowns: Package availability after a later authorized repository check or package download
PostgreSQL server and matching server development headers / pgvector install
NFS server-side sync export and actual PGDATA locking/fsync behavior
Vfolder persistence after session restart or recreation and quota enforcement
Consistent database-plus-related-files backup to A40 and tested restore

proposed_next_small_test_not_executed: In a later installation test, install a matching PostgreSQL server/pgvector in the H200 environment, use a dedicated vfolder subdirectory and local-only socket for a small cluster, insert and read a pinned text/vector sample, restart only the PostgreSQL process and reread the same PGDATA, then verify a separate database dump and restore. Confirm vfolder persistence across session replacement during a later planned migration without ending the current session for this test. Do not open external port 5432 by default.
